structure.unit: Provisions Applicable to Probate and Nonprobate Transfers
Uniform Disclaimer of Property Interests Act

law.catch_line: Disclaimer by appointee, object, or taker in default of exercise of power of appointment

text.section: A disclaimer of an interest in property by an appointee of a power of appointment takes effect as of the time the instrument by which the holder exercises the power becomes irrevocable.
A disclaimer of an interest in property by an object or taker in default of an exercise of a power of appointment takes effect as of the time the instrument creating the power becomes irrevocable.
